en.services_desc: Senior software architecture, system modularization, and full-stack engineering delivered with precision for mission-critical businesses.
en.srv1_problem: Eliminate technical debt and deployment bottlenecks by decoupling tangled monoliths into resilient, testable micro-modules.
en.srv1_d1: Domain-Driven Design (DDD) bounded contexts & decoupled domains
en.srv1_d2: Standalone modules with clean, documented contract interfaces
en.srv1_d3: Automated regression test harness enforcing strict TDD
en.srv1_fit: Growing scale-ups, fintechs & mature enterprise codebases
en.srv2_problem: Accelerate product delivery with high-performance, maintainable web systems built from day one on solid architectural foundations.
en.srv2_d1: High-throughput backend architectures in PHP/Laravel, Node.js
en.srv2_d2: Responsive, accessible frontends in modern JavaScript, React, Vue
en.srv2_d3: Robust REST / GraphQL APIs with comprehensive contract testing
en.srv2_fit: Startups launching MVPs & scale-ups deploying new portals
en.srv3_problem: Resolve sluggish response times, database locks, and stability issues during heavy operational traffic spikes.
en.srv3_d1: Comprehensive query profiling & MySQL / PostgreSQL index tuning
en.srv3_d3: Architectural code quality audit & technical debt assessment
en.srv4_problem: Gain clarity and strategic direction on critical architectural decisions before committing months of engineering effort.
en.srv4_d1: System design blueprints & tech stack viability evaluations
en.srv4_d2: 1-on-1 strategic discovery sessions with founders & tech leads
en.srv4_d3: Actionable engineering roadmap & squad architecture mentorship
en.srv4_fit: Founders, CTOs & engineering teams scaling their architecture
